scope: Independent bounded source and safety review of normal MainWindow access to the existing offline Demo/CSV advanced terminal; one additional guarded lifecycle probe.
source_integrity: Independently read and hashed all three files; hashes equal frozen candidate and independent probe before/after hashes. No candidate source mutations by reviewer.

findings.subject: Bounded integration meets reviewed requirements
findings.detail: MainWindow adds a discoverable QAction, lazily imports AdvancedTerminal only on invocation, and does not invoke the standalone launcher. Adapter reuses Terminal within the existing QApplication, establishes an owned top-level window, restores geometry after parenting, applies QSS locally, and uses WA_DeleteOnClose. Accepted closure releases the reference synchronously; identity checks prevent an old deferred destruction from clearing a replacement. Main close cascades to its terminal and auxiliary windows. Existing six-page construction is unchanged. Existing Demo/CSV provenance and disabled orders remain in reused implementation.

findings.subject: Native desktop and full product acceptance excluded
findings.detail: Offscreen lifecycle/state and raise/activate calls do not establish visible Windows foreground focus, physical monitor behavior, packaging, clean installation, live providers, licenses, real orders, or full product readiness. Root reports visual inspection of captures; this reviewer inspected capture metadata only. Existing compact-header/icon limitations reported by root are not closed by this review.

findings.subject: Rollback is statically reviewed, not executed by reviewer
findings.detail: Roundtrip script is suitable for the frozen, isolated candidate under listed conditions. Actual rollback, fresh baseline, reinstatement, protected-primary comparison, and post-reinstatement verification remain coordinator gates; this report is not their completion evidence.

qt_capture.scope: Actual offscreen MainWindow QAction route; image metadata read here, visual inspection attributed to coordinator.

safety_review.guard: Genuine OS metadata resolves before audit installation. Audit hooks are installed before project/provider imports and deny audited socket/network and real process starts. This is Python audit coverage, not an OS-level sandbox or proof against native-library networking. Inspected integration adds no provider, network, credential, process or order path.
safety_review.state_isolation: Runner uses task-owned state/layout; new tests and independent probe use temporary state/layout. Terminal uses explicit INI settings and local QSS; implicit open/close does not write layout. Existing explicit save/reset behavior remains scoped to the terminal layout file.
safety_review.protected_primary: Reviewer did not open, modify or execute code in protected primary. Reused check_primary reads its Git status/HEAD/branch and SHA256 manifest and compares against recovery_evidence/primary_before.json; fresh preservation verification remains coordinator-owned. It is not a whole-tree hash or protection against arbitrary external concurrent changes.
safety_review.reviewer_prohibited_actions: No network/provider/model CLI/credentials/payments/email/Git mutations, protected-primary mutations, source changes or full-suite rerun performed.

rollback_conditions: Keep source freeze and exclusive candidate ownership throughout rehearsal; no concurrent source writer or background test importing candidate while files move.
Require exact base HEAD, feature branch, core.autocrlf=true, no optimization, protected-primary manifest unchanged, no staged files and exact frozen hashes.
Before mutation preserve byte-exact backups of all three files; new adapter and test must remain untracked; verify resolved candidate targets remain within candidate root and are not symlinks.
Restore main_window.py from base with expected CRLF normalization and verify Git blob identity and no application diff; move only two named new files into retained task evidence, without deletion.
Run fresh guarded baseline after rollback timestamp: exactly 19 tests, no failures/errors/skips/denied events, stable restored-base hash.
Reinstate only from verified retained backups/retired originals; verify all three exact frozen hashes and protected-primary manifest afterward; coordinator must complete post-reinstatement check.
If any check fails, stop phase, preserve original and partial evidence, record failure, and resolve explicitly rather than deleting evidence or assuming successful restoration.

delivery_plan_review.assessment: 19 October is a working target and prioritization plan, not completed delivery or guaranteed production acceptance. Plan preserves external provider/licensing/device dependencies and distinguishes the current menu integration from full UI completion. No future milestone is accepted by this report.
